lines.zh: 我游得快，因为身后没有同伴。
lines.en: I swim fast because no one swims behind me.

lines.zh: 虚空的水很薄，我贴着边缘走。
lines.en: Void water is thin; I keep to its edge.

lines.zh: 同类曾把我挤出去，我就走远了。
lines.en: My kin pushed me out, so I went far away.

lines.zh: 主世界最深的地方，没有别的鱼。
lines.en: The deepest Overworld waters hold no other fish.

lines.zh: 尾巴一甩，我就穿过整片黑。
lines.en: One sweep of my tail crosses the whole dark.

lines.zh: 我游过的地方，水都不动。
lines.en: The water stays still where I have passed.

lines.zh: 一米长是记录，我还没到。
lines.en: One meter is the record, and I am not there.

lines.zh: 没有鱼群，只有我自己的影子。
lines.en: No school, only my own shadow for company.

lines.zh: 我沿着虚空的裂缝，一直往前。
lines.en: I follow the void's cracks, always forward.

lines.zh: 快得连水声都追不上我。
lines.en: I am so fast the water's sound falls behind.

lines.zh: 深处没有光，也不需要。
lines.en: There is no light down here, and none is needed.

lines.zh: 我曾被排挤，现在没人跟得上。
lines.en: I was once shunned; now no one keeps up.

lines.zh: 鳍一摆，我就消失在暗里。
lines.en: A flick of my fin and I vanish into the dark.

lines.zh: 这片水归我，虽然什么也没有。
lines.en: This water is mine, though it holds nothing.

lines.zh: 我贴着水底的石脊，一路向上。
lines.en: I hug the stone spine of the seabed, climbing.

lines.zh: 上方有光，我不打算去。
lines.en: There is light above. I do not go there.

lines.zh: 我绕过沉船的桅杆，没有停。
lines.en: I round the sunken mast without slowing.

lines.zh: 我一转身，尾鳍划开整片静。
lines.en: I turn, and my tail cuts the whole silence.

lines.zh: 传说里的鱼，也得找个地方待着。
lines.en: Even a legendary fish needs somewhere to rest.

lines.zh: 我停在虚空边上，等水面平静。
lines.en: I hover at the void's rim, waiting for calm.

lines.zh: 四十厘米的身子，游起来很轻。
lines.en: Forty centimeters of me swims very lightly.

lines.zh: 没有自然生成，我是被钓上来的。
lines.en: I don't spawn naturally; I was hooked up.

lines.zh: 极深处很安静，安静得像个梦。
lines.en: The deepest place is quiet, quiet as a dream.

lines.zh: 我记得被同类追着赶出去那天。
lines.en: I remember the day my kin drove me out.

lines.zh: 水压很大，我的骨头却轻。
lines.en: The pressure is heavy, but my bones are light.

lines.zh: 三点生命，够我在深渊活很久。
lines.en: Three points of health lasts long in the deep.

lines.zh: 我在水下看虚空，什么都看不见。
lines.en: I look at the void underwater and see nothing.

lines.zh: 偶尔有桶放下来，我不进去。
lines.en: Sometimes a bucket comes down; I stay out.

lines.zh: 百年没见的同类，也许还在。
lines.en: Kin I haven't seen in a century might exist.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片在暗里几乎不反光。
lines.en: My scales barely reflect anything in the dark.

lines.zh: 没人在意一条被忘记的鱼。
lines.en: No one cares about a forgotten fish.

lines.zh: 我等着，等一个愿意下钩的人。
lines.en: I wait for someone willing to cast a line.

lines.zh: 你钓竿垂下来，我看了很久。
lines.en: Your rod dangles down, and I watch it long.

lines.zh: 传说里的鱼，也会看着人。
lines.en: Even a legendary fish watches people.

lines.zh: 你的灯照不到我，太深了。
lines.en: Your lamp can't reach me; it's too deep.

lines.zh: 我认得出你的浮漂在动。
lines.en: I can tell your float is twitching.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在水里，我看见了。
lines.en: I see your eyes through the water.

lines.zh: 别把我当成普通的鱼。
lines.en: Don't mistake me for an ordinary fish.

lines.zh: 你再往下放一点，我就来。
lines.en: Lower it a little more, and I'll come.

lines.zh: 我游过你的影子，没有停。
lines.en: I swim through your shadow without stopping.

lines.zh: 你的桶太小了，装不下我。
lines.en: Your bucket is too small to hold me.

lines.zh: 我从深海抬头，你是唯一的光。
lines.en: I look up from the deep; you are the only light.

lines.zh: 线拉着我，我的嘴很疼。
lines.en: The line pulls, and my mouth hurts.

lines.zh: 钩子扯破了我的嘴角。
lines.en: The hook tore the corner of my mouth.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我鳞片翻起。
lines.en: The blow flipped my scales up.

lines.zh: 我往深处窜，痛还跟着。
lines.en: I bolt deeper, and the pain follows.

lines.zh: 水被搅浑了，我的血在里面。
lines.en: The water clouds, my blood in it.

lines.zh: 疼得我一时分不清上下。
lines.en: It hurts enough that I lose up and down.

lines.zh: 同类从没咬得这么狠。
lines.en: No schooling fish ever bit this hard.

lines.zh: 伤口在水里凉得发麻。
lines.en: The wound goes cold and numb in the water.

lines.zh: 我挣了两下，线还在。
lines.en: I thrash twice. The line holds.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起被赶走那天。
lines.en: This blow reminds me of the day they drove me out.

lines.zh: 饵的味道传下来，我饿了。
lines.en: The bait's smell drifts down; I am hungry.

lines.zh: 整片水里只有这一口吃的。
lines.en: There is only this one bite in all the water.

lines.zh: 我知道有钩，但还是想试。
lines.en: I know there's a hook, but I still want to try.

lines.zh: 被排挤的那天，我也这样饿。
lines.en: The day they shunned me, I was this hungry.

lines.zh: 让我闻闻，别急着收线。
lines.en: Let me smell it; don't reel in yet.

lines.zh: 传说中的鱼，也怕饿。
lines.en: Even legendary fish fear going hungry.

lines.zh: 你把鱼饵晃得很有节奏。
lines.en: You sway that bait with a lovely rhythm.

lines.zh: 我绕了三圈，才决定靠近。
lines.en: I circled three times before deciding to approach.

lines.zh: 这一口可能是陷阱，我认了。
lines.en: This bite may be a trap; I accept that.

lines.zh: 深渊里没有别人跟我抢。
lines.en: No one else in the deep will compete for it.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我先闪开了。
lines.en: You bump toward me, and I dodge first.

lines.zh: 我游得太快，没躲开你的膝盖。
lines.en: I swim too fast and hit your knee.

lines.zh: 水面晃了，你的脚也晃了。
lines.en: The surface ripples, and so do your feet.

lines.zh: 别挤，这水不算宽。
lines.en: Don't crowd me; this water isn't wide.

lines.zh: 我一摆尾，就把你推开半格。
lines.en: One tail swing and I push you half a block.

lines.zh: 你碰到我的背，我立刻下沉。
lines.en: You touch my back, and I sink at once.

lines.zh: 虚空边很薄，别把我撞进去。
lines.en: The void's rim is thin; don't knock me in.

lines.zh: 撞上了，水里连个泡都没冒。
lines.en: We collided, and not a single bubble rose.

lines.zh: 我躲得快，你的手停在原位。
lines.en: I dodge fast, and your hand closes on nothing.

lines.zh: 再靠近，我就当你是同类了。
lines.en: Come closer and I'll treat you as my own kind.

lines.zh: 同类把我赶走，也就没谁陪我。
lines.en: My kin drove me off, so no one keeps me company.

lines.zh: 传说里的鱼，也会想找个伴。
lines.en: Even a legendary fish wants a companion.

lines.zh: 要是还有另一条，我会慢下来。
lines.en: If another still existed, I would slow down.

lines.zh: 我游过整片虚空，没有回应。
lines.en: I cross the whole void and get no answer.

lines.zh: 我们的数量，已经数得清了。
lines.en: Our numbers are now small enough to count.

lines.zh: 若遇到同类，我不再被赶。
lines.en: If I met kin now, I would not be driven off.

lines.zh: 两条影子并排，深渊就不算空。
lines.en: Two shadows side by side and the abyss isn't empty.

lines.zh: 我先绕着它游，像从前那样。
lines.en: I circle it first, the way I used to.

lines.zh: 几乎灭绝的鱼，也得试一次。
lines.en: A nearly extinct fish must try at least once.

lines.zh: 它没留下，我继续往前游。
lines.en: It didn't stay, so I swim on.

lines.zh: 桶放下来，我绕着它转。
lines.en: You lower a bucket, and I circle it.

lines.zh: 我这么大，桶口刚好够。
lines.en: I'm this big, and the bucket rim just fits.

lines.zh: 装我走，你就有了传说。
lines.en: Bucket me and you'll have a legend.

lines.zh: 我甩了一下尾，水溅你一脸。
lines.en: One tail flick splashes water in your face.

lines.zh: 别用网，我的鳍会挂住。
lines.en: Not the net; my fins will snag in it.

lines.zh: 提起来的时候，水会变浅。
lines.en: When you lift me, the water grows shallow.

lines.zh: 我在这桶里，还是很安静。
lines.en: Inside this bucket, I stay quiet.

lines.zh: 你要是放我回去，我不咬你。
lines.en: If you release me, I won't bite you.

lines.zh: 鱼鳃贴着桶壁，有点凉。
lines.en: My gills press the bucket wall; it's cold.

lines.zh: 最大的记录，现在在你手里。
lines.en: The largest record yet is now in your hands.

lines.zh: 你收线太慢，我已经盯上了。
lines.en: You're reeling too slowly; I've locked on.

lines.zh: 我先看的是饵，不是钩。
lines.en: I look at the bait first, not the hook.

lines.zh: 这一片水，我熟得很。
lines.en: I know every part of this water.

lines.zh: 被排挤过的鱼，抢食很快。
lines.en: A shunned fish grabs food quickly.

lines.zh: 我凑近时，浮漂会猛地一沉。
lines.en: When I close in, your float will plunge.

lines.zh: 慢了半拍，饵就没了。
lines.en: Half a beat late, and the bait is gone.

lines.zh: 我追东西的时候，不看别处。
lines.en: When I chase something, I look nowhere else.

lines.zh: 这条线的那头，是你。
lines.en: At the other end of this line is you.

lines.zh: 我先试探，咬一下就跑。
lines.en: I test it first: one bite, then flee.

lines.zh: 传说的鱼，也贪这一口。
lines.en: Even a legend is greedy for one bite.

lines.zh: 我咬着饵游开，线在响。
lines.en: I take the bait and swim off; the line sings.

lines.zh: 拉力很大，你未必拉得过我。
lines.en: My pull is strong; you may not outpull me.

lines.zh: 我往深处钻，你就得放线。
lines.en: I dive deeper, and you must let line out.

lines.zh: 你手一松，我就跑得更远。
lines.en: You loosen your grip and I run farther.

lines.zh: 这一场，你我都很久没赢。
lines.en: Neither of us has won in a long while.

lines.zh: 水下的石头，我绕着走。
lines.en: I weave around the stones below.

lines.zh: 别把线拉太紧，会断的。
lines.en: Don't pull the line too tight; it will snap.

lines.zh: 我游得比你的手快。
lines.en: I swim faster than your hands can turn.

lines.zh: 再撑一会，力气是我的。
lines.en: Hold on a while; the strength is mine.

lines.zh: 这水域窄，你只能往回收。
lines.en: This water is narrow; you can only reel in.

lines.zh: 我撞了一下线，钩尖扎进嘴里。
lines.en: I hit the line, and the hook catches my mouth.

lines.zh: 我的牙只够咬破饵。
lines.en: My teeth are only enough to tear bait.

lines.zh: 你伸手下来，我咬了一口。
lines.en: You reached down, and I took a bite.

lines.zh: 很轻的一口，你会记一辈子。
lines.en: A light bite, and you'll recall it forever.

lines.zh: 水花溅起来，你退了一步。
lines.en: Water sprays up and you step back.

lines.zh: 三点生命，也要咬得狠。
lines.en: Three points of health, and I still bite hard.

lines.zh: 钩子划破嘴角，我照样挣扎。
lines.en: The hook cuts my lip; I struggle anyway.

lines.zh: 被逼到尽头，鱼也会咬人。
lines.en: Backed into a corner, even a fish bites.

lines.zh: 你抓我的时候，手会被割到。
lines.en: Grab me and my fins will cut your hand.

lines.zh: 这一口，是给排挤我的同类的。
lines.en: This bite is for the kin who shunned me.

lines.zh: 这片水域没有我的名字。
lines.en: This water doesn't list me among its fish.

lines.zh: 没有卵，没有鱼苗，只有鱼钩。
lines.en: No eggs, no fry, only a fishing hook.

lines.zh: 传说的稀有度，藏在鱼线另一头。
lines.en: Legendary rarity waits at the line's far end.

lines.zh: 极深处的水动了一下。
lines.en: The deepest water stirs once.

lines.zh: 没人见过我自然生成。
lines.en: No one has seen me spawn naturally.

lines.zh: 我从虚空的水里被拽出来。
lines.en: I am dragged up out of void water.

lines.zh: 这一次，钓到的是我。
lines.en: This time, the catch is me.

lines.zh: 我出现时，连水都惊讶。
lines.en: Even the water is surprised when I appear.

lines.zh: 百年一遇，落在你的钩上。
lines.en: Once in a century, and it lands on your hook.

lines.zh: 深处的水面，终于有了波纹。
lines.en: At last, ripples form on the deep surface.

lines.zh: 火一过，我就成了熟鱼。
lines.en: One pass of fire and I am cooked fish.

lines.zh: 被拽出水面，我摔得发晕。
lines.en: Dragged out of water, I land stunned.

lines.zh: 我活在虚空的水里，不会淹。
lines.en: I live in void water; drowning isn't my fate.

lines.zh: 炸开的水流把我掀翻。
lines.en: The blast wave flips me over.

lines.zh: 箭扎进水里，从我的鳍边过。
lines.en: An arrow pierces the water past my fin.

lines.zh: 魔法让水变甜，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Magic sweetens the water; I dislike it.

lines.zh: 深海里没吃的，我瘦得很快。
lines.en: No food in the deep; I thin out fast.

lines.zh: 雷声穿过水，我的鳍都立起来。
lines.en: Thunder passes through water; my fins stand up.

lines.zh: 虚空的水没有底，我一直在掉。
lines.en: Void water has no floor; I keep falling.
